items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Bob has recorded and performed with a long list of major artists including Sarah Vaughn, Art Pepper, Linda Ronstadt and Roger Kellaway.

ctx.x: Bob Magnusson was born in New York City on February 24, 1947 and grew up in San Diego surrounded by music. He first played French horn and took up the bass in 1967, joining the Buddy Rich band a year later. Bob has recorded and performed with a long list of major artists including Sarah Vaughn, Art Pepper, Linda Ronstadt and Roger Kellaway. He lives in San Diego where he often performs with flautist Holly Hofmann and pianist Mike Wofford.
Bob was interviewed in Los Angeles on February 14, 1999, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
